cond_0078.intro: We are looking for a Policy Configuration Analyst I to join our team. The role is responsible for developing and processing Rule Maintenance Requests (RMRs) and configuring the associated rules for each release by the configuration cutoff date on the Release Schedule.
cond_0078.responsibilities:
Translating client terminology into [Company name masked] configuration lingo (and vice versa), staying in regular contact with clients and internal teams to clarify meaning on both sides.
Actively monitoring the PR queues in the PRMs database to ensure all requests are processed for the appropriate Release Month, and connecting with upstream teams quickly when issues arise.
Processing Ad-Hoc PRs in a timely manner, ensuring each request is completed by the PR Cut Off date on the Release Schedule.
Completing additional PR training for more complex client needs, including Complex Max Units loads, CCI Deviations, Named Set Table loads, Mappings, and any additional work as required.
Processing client switches associated with Ad-Hoc PRs in a timely manner, ensuring each switch is completed by the Switch Management Cut Off date on the Release Schedule.
Developing and processing RMRs to modify existing rule versions, ensuring rules for [Company name masked] clients are configured in accordance with the rule descriptions and instructions on each request.
Processing RMRs in a timely manner, ensuring each request is completed by the Configuration Cut Off date on the Release Schedule. This includes actively monitoring the Configuration queues in the RMRs database to ensure all requests are processed for the appropriate Release Month.
Configuring rules and tables in accordance with configuration guidelines in the appropriate Teamroom, training document, departmental job aids, or Process Guidelines in the Document Management System (DMS).
Documenting action taken for each RMR in the appropriate field of the RMR.
Running QA for each rule associated with RMRs processed, including running QA for each RMR reviewed when performing Peer Review responsibilities.
Assisting in the analysis and troubleshooting of erroneous results, and actively raising issues early so they can be resolved quickly.
Reviewing and completing Research Requests associated with the Rule QA report.
Communicating effectively and promptly with upstream functional areas to resolve issues — initiating contact when needed rather than waiting for problems to escalate.
Maintaining the following accuracy targets for rule configuration: 95% Rule configuration accuracy, 98% RMR resolution accuracy, 98% Rule Reference accuracy, 80% RMR creation accuracy.
Meeting daily and monthly production and quality targets; maintaining an exemplary level of accuracy in all work; ensuring that the capture and completion of assigned projects are QA'd per policy and corrections are made if needed.
Maintaining working knowledge of CDM functionality.
Successfully and accurately performing table loads.
Point Release Assistance.
Other duties as assigned.

cond_0198.responsibilities:
Coordinate with clients and internal teams to translate client terminology into [Company name masked] configuration language (and vice versa).
Process Ad-Hoc PRs in a timely manner, working to ensure each request is completed by the PR Cut Off date on the Release Schedule.
Complete additional PR training for more complex client needs, including Complex Max Units loads, CCI Deviations, Named Set Table loads, Mappings, and any additional work as required.
Monitor the PR queues in the PRMs database together with the team to help ensure all requests are processed for the appropriate Release Month.
Process client switches associated with Ad-Hoc PRs in a timely manner, helping ensure each switch is completed by the Switch Management Cut Off date on the Release Schedule.
Work with the team to develop and process RMRs that modify existing rule versions, ensuring rules for [Company name masked] clients are configured in accordance with the rule descriptions and instructions on each request.
Process RMRs in a timely manner, including monitoring the Configuration queues in the RMRs database to help ensure all requests are processed for the appropriate Release Month.
Configure rules and tables in accordance with configuration guidelines in the appropriate Teamroom, training document, departmental job aids, or Process Guidelines in the Document Management System (DMS).
Document action taken for each RMR in the appropriate field.
Run QA for each rule associated with processed RMRs, including when performing Peer Review responsibilities.
Assist in the analysis and troubleshooting of erroneous results.
Review and complete Research Requests associated with the Rule QA report.
Communicate effectively and in a timely manner with upstream functional areas to help resolve issues.
Maintain the following accuracy targets for rule configuration: 95% Rule configuration accuracy, 98% RMR resolution accuracy, 98% Rule Reference accuracy, 80% RMR creation accuracy.
Meet daily and monthly production and quality targets; maintain accuracy in all work; ensure assigned projects are QA'd per policy and corrections are made if needed.
Maintain working knowledge of CDM functionality.
Accurately perform table loads.
Provide Point Release Assistance.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0198.requirements:
Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.
Prefer CPC, CCS, or RHIA certification.
Ability to learn and quickly apply new material.
Ability to adapt to changing situations with ease.
Team player with strong desire to assist others and share knowledge.
Excellent analytical skills with ability to troubleshoot problems and find root causes.
1-Year [Company name masked] experience or industry experience.
Must have flexibility and willingness to participate in the work processes of an international organization, including conference calls scheduled to accommodate global time zones.
After hours and/or weekend work required where necessary for major deliverables/deadlines (not consistent).
Must have ability to positively handle/manage stress, such as high work volume and frequent change.
